text.insert: A view, not a store: tactics are re-extractable views over attempt evidence, so a better extractor improves every tactic retroactively. Retrieval is graph traversal — by target (everything ever done to this file, its siblings, its analogs, and the tactics that worked there) and by tactic (this symptom → which tactics, validated on which attempts). Per the
, the controlled vocabulary is exactly the ten mismatch-pattern categories, with free-text signatures underneath. Events regime (view). Exists today: no — the categories are hardcoded in

text.insert: Today's baseline is weaker than this file implies: the

builder keyword-matches ten hand-written buckets against already-curated prose — never against live checkpoint or objdiff data — and no store links a tactic tried to the score delta it produced. That association exists only in free-text notes and unread transcripts; creating it during condensation is the librarian's defining new capability.
